Name: Nova Relay
Description: Keys for Nova Relay (Zaxcom Nova, through the Aria-8 or direct): transport, Slate and Com, logging (scene, take, notes), arming and arm sets, PFL, headphones, routing, input pages, jams, meters, receivers, drive/battery/mirror status, trim and headphone dials. Keys light up with the recorder's state.
Author: GFS Sound

Actions.Name: REC
Actions.Tooltip: Start recording (hold, like the REC button on screen). Red while recording, with the take time.

Actions.Name: STOP
Actions.Tooltip: Stop recording (a short hold while recording, so a bump can't end a take).

Actions.Name: Tone
Actions.Tooltip: Tone on (hold) and off (tap). Green while tone is on.

Actions.Name: Scream trim
Actions.Tooltip: Panic button for loud screams: drops the transmitters chosen in Nova Relay (Setup › Scream trim) to the scream ZNet trim; tap again to put them back. Amber while on.

Actions.Name: Slate mic
Actions.Tooltip: The slate mic, like holding the Aria's Slate button: on while the key is held (or tap on, tap off).

Actions.Name: Com mic
Actions.Tooltip: The com mic, like holding the Aria's Com button (learn it once in Nova Relay › Setup › Stream Deck).

Actions.Name: Headphones
Actions.Tooltip: Next, previous or a chosen headphone preset. Shows the preset's name.

Actions.Name: Arm track
Actions.Tooltip: Arm or disarm a track (or all tracks). Shows the track's name; red when armed. New Arm keys take the next free track, so a folder fills up 1, 2, 3…

Actions.Name: PFL
Actions.Tooltip: PFL the input on an Aria fader (or turn every PFL off). Yellow while on. New PFL keys take the next free fader.

Actions.Name: Timecode & take
Actions.Tooltip: Shows timecode, record state, scene and take. Press to open Nova Relay.

Actions.Name: Drive time left
Actions.Tooltip: Recording time left on the drive at the armed track count. Amber under 1 hour, red under 15 minutes (adjustable).

Actions.Name: Battery
Actions.Tooltip: The Nova's battery voltage. Amber under 14.0 V, red under 13.0 V (adjustable for your batteries).

Actions.Name: Primary free
Actions.Tooltip: Free space on the primary drive. Amber under 20 GB, red under 5 GB (adjustable).

Actions.Name: Mirror
Actions.Tooltip: Mirror mode and progress. Amber when 3 files behind or mirroring is off, red when 10 behind (adjustable).

Actions.Name: Next scene
Actions.Tooltip: Next scene number (075A → 076) or next letter (075 → 075A); a new scene starts at take 1. Shows the scene it will set.

Actions.Name: Take +1 / −1
Actions.Tooltip: Moves the next take up or down by one. Shows the next take.

Actions.Name: Note
Actions.Tooltip: A note preset (or your own words) on the take: the one recording, else the next. Press again to clear it. Purple while it's on.

Actions.Name: Last take
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the last recorded take: scene, take, length and note.

Actions.Name: Arm set
Actions.Tooltip: Arms exactly a saved group of tracks (the others off). Red when exactly that set is armed. Locked while recording.

Actions.Name: Meter
Actions.Tooltip: A live level for a track or an output.

Actions.Name: Receiver
Actions.Tooltip: A receiver's frequency, transmitter state and ZNet trim. Amber when its transmitter is on standby, low power or waking.

Actions.Name: Input page
Actions.Tooltip: Opens (or closes) an input's page on the Nova, like the Aria's page buttons. Blue while open.

Actions.Name: Route
Actions.Tooltip: Puts Tone, Slate, Com 1, Com 2, a track (OUT 5–8) or an input (OUT 1–4) on an output, or takes it off. Teal while routed.

Actions.Name: Jam
Actions.Tooltip: Jams timecode from the reader (TC), user bits, the date or time of day. Hold to jam; not while recording.

Actions.Name: Trim (dial)
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to trim an input 1 dB per click, or a transmitter’s ZNet trim (gain) 1 step per click. The strip shows the input, its track and the value.

Actions.Name: Fader (dial)
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to move an input's Aria fader; press to pull it all the way down, press again to bring it back. The strip shows the input, its track and where Nova Relay last put the fader.

Actions.Name: Fader step
Actions.Tooltip: Nudges an input's Aria fader up or down a step; hold to keep going. Shows where Nova Relay last put it.

Actions.Name: Headphones (dial)
Actions.Tooltip: Turn for the next or previous headphone preset. The strip shows its name.
